a: Dummies fill parameter lists but are never used.
Fakes work with simplified implementations (in-memory DB).
Stubs provide canned answers to calls.
Mocks verify interactions were made as expected.
Spies wrap real objects and record calls.
Mock external systems; prefer fakes for your own domain logic.
Over-mocking couples tests to implementation details.
Contracts test real integration boundaries; mocks isolate units.
Freeze time for deterministic scheduling tests.
Seed RNGs for reproducible randomized tests.
